Coast - Tustin Sector (SNAS).description:
Tustin Sector is a combination arrival/enroute sector and is responsible for: 

a. Sequencing IFR KSNA RWY 02/20 arrivals. 
b. Enroute IFR traffic.
c. Establishing the approach sequence to KFUL when either the LOC RWY 24 or GPS RWY 24 is advertised as the primary approach. 

NOTE - Even though Tustin Sector may be responsible for setting the approach sequence for KFUL, Tustin Sector must still point out all approach aircraft to Beach Sector because the aircraft will enter Beach airspace.
